Graduate Application Fee Waivers
Graduate Application Fee Waivers
OSU is able to grant application fee waivers to applicants who meet specific criteria.
Application Fee Waiver Request Process
Start your graduate education online application, in the fee waiver section select the "I need to a apply for a fee waiver".
Select the type of fee waiver.
Upload the required documents
Wait for your application fee waiver to be reviewed by Graduate Admissions. The time it takes to receive your decision can vary. Graduate Admissions may contact you for additional information or updated documents during the review process.
Decisions on fee waiver request will be posted in your application status portal. If your fee waiver is approved, your application will be moved forward. If your fee if not approved, a link to the fee payment portal will be provided.

Financial Need Fee Waiver
Eligibility
Individuals experiencing financial hardship who can provide supporting documentation. Must be a domestic applicant. International applicants, see bottom of this section.
Required Documentation
Applicants need to provide an electronic version of one of the following documents. The document must show the applicant's full name, dates confirming that the award or benefit is current, as well as the name of the specific organization providing assistance. Screen shots will not be accepted.
FAFSA Submission Summary.
Proof of being a SNAP participant
Documentation of dislocated worker benefit eligibility
A benefits verification letter or a benefits summary letter from the U.S. Department of Veteran’s Affairs indicating participation in or eligibility for rehabilitation services.
Scholar Program Participant Fee Waiver
Eligibility
Participated in one of the following scholar programs: McNair, MARC U-STAR, Louis Stokes Alliances for Minorities (LSAMP), Gates Millennium Scholars, GEM, Ford Family Foundation, TRIO Student Support Services (SSS), RISE, and SACNAS conference attendees.
Required Documentation
An email or letter from your program director confirming your successful participation. Visit our Scholar Incentive Program for more information. GEM fellows will upload their application confirmation email or a screenshot of their GEM application status page showing Oregon State as a selected graduate school or confirmation of participation (if already a fellow).
Public Health, DVM, and PharmD Applicants
Several Oregon State professional programs like the Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM), PharmD, and some programs in the College of Health require applicants to complete an application outside of the graduate education application system. Graduate Admissions cannot provide waivers for these external applications. Learn more about fee waivers/fee reductions on the DVM, PharmD, Public Health affiliated application websites. OSU can provide fee waivers for the supplemental questions portion of the College of Health application that is completed through the graduate education application.
International Applicant Fee Waivers
OSU does not have application fee waivers for international students. International applicants can check with their local EducationUSA advising office to see if there are educational opportunity programs or local recommendations to fund study in the United States.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I request an application fee waiver for more than one graduate application?
OSU will provide a fee waiver for one application. Please write the program you would like the waiver applied on the Graduate Application Fee Waiver request form.
I already submitted my application. Can I receive an application fee waiver?
Fee waivers can be applied only to applications that have not been submitted.
I meet the eligibility requirements for both the financial need and scholar program participant waivers. Should I complete two Graduate Application Fee Waiver request forms?
You only need to complete one Graduate Application Fee Waiver request form. Select the eligibility you wish you to be reviewed (financial need or scholar program).
Are there application fee waivers for Active Military or a Veteran not receiving rehabilitation benefits?
OSU does not have waivers for Active Military. For Active Military and Veterans not receiving rehabilitation benefits, visit the Military & Veteran Resources page to explore opportunities and resources.
Do you offer application fee waivers to Peace Corps or AmeriCorps volunteers?
OSU does not offer application fee waivers for Peace Corps or AmeriCorps volunteers. Volunteers should check if they meet our financial need eligibility.
My program application deadline is approaching and my application fee waiver request is pending. What should I do?
It is to your discretion to submit your application with or without the fee waiver to meet your program’s deadline. Submitted applications are no longer eligible for an application fee waiver, and your application fee payment is non-refundable. This is why we recommend submitting your waiver request at least two weeks before your program deadline.
Contact
